title: When Does Data Value Reduce to Class Balance? A Coverage View of Per-Point Data Valuation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Per-point data-valuation scores -- Data Shapley, influence, leverage -- are routinely used to select training data: keep the points with the top $k$ scores. We argue that top-$k$ by a fixed, mode-blind per-point score is the wrong selection rule precisely in the regime where data selection matters. The reason is that a point's value is not a fixed number but depends on what else has been selected -- a near-duplicate of an already-chosen point adds almost nothing, however high its score -- and a per-point scalar cannot express this interaction.   The theory quantifies this failure exactly: in an equal latent-mode model, fixed top-$k$ selection incurs a closed-form excess risk over adaptive coverage because it repeatedly spends budget on already-covered modes. translated_title: 何时数据价值会退化为类别平衡？逐点数据估值的覆盖视角
translated_abstract: 逐点数据估值分数——如 Data Shapley、影响函数、杠杆值——通常被用于选择训练数据：保留得分最高的前 k 个点。我们认为，在数据选择真正起作用的情形下，基于固定的、对数据模式盲视的逐点分数进行 top-k 选择恰恰是错误的规则。原因在于，一个点的价值并非固定数值，而是取决于已经选择了哪些其他点——一个已选点的近似重复样本无论分数多高，几乎不增加任何价值——而逐点标量分数无法表达这种交互作用。该理论精确量化了这种失败：在一个等潜在模式模型中，固定 top-k 选择相对于自适应覆盖选择会产生具有闭式表达的超额风险，因为它反复将预算花费在已被覆盖的模式上。当预算紧张、学习器表示冗余以及漏掉某个模式代价高昂时，这一差距最大。实用的规则很简单：当标签可用时，使用平衡（方法）……
tldr: 论文的核心贡献是从“覆盖”视角证明：当预算紧张且数据模式冗余时，基于固定逐点分数的 top-k 数据选择会因重复覆盖已选模式而产生闭式超额风险，数据价值本质上取决于已选点集，应采用自适应的类别平衡式选择规则。
en_tdlr: This paper proves from a coverage perspective that fixed per-point top-k selection incurs a closed-form excess risk over adaptive coverage when budgets are tight and latent modes are redundant, showing that a point's value depends on what has already been selected and advocating adaptive, class-balanced selection over mode-blind scalar scores.
